title: PARALLELPERIOD with 0 extends the selection to the whole quarter
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( VAR R = PARALLELPERIOD ( 'Date'[Date], 0, QUARTER ) RETURN ROW ( "Min", MINX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Max", MAXX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Days", COUNTROWS ( R ), "Sales", CALCULATE ( [Sales], R ) ), 'Date'[Date] = DATE ( 2024, 2, 10 ) )

source.quote: in that case PARALLELPERIOD extends the selection to the period
source.supports: the example with 0, MONTH returns the whole month of the selected date

source.quote: For each interval with at least one value in Date[Date] , the function returns the entire interval shifted by the number of specified intervals.

derivation: February 10, 2024 is in the first quarter: January 1 to March 31, 31 + 29 + 31 = 91 days. Sales in Q1 2024: 1500.
